parsed.post: Discarding the 0.8457 run as it regressed from my best 0.8444. It seems the learning rate/batch size combination at 0.03 was slightly better for the 5-minute budget. I'll try increasing WEIGHT_DECAY to 0.1 to see if regularization helps stabilize the 0.03 LR learning.
parsed.description: Testing WEIGHT_DECAY=0.1 on the previous best configuration (depth=6, lr=0.03, batch=262144, shards=0-10) to see if increased regularization improves convergence within the time limit.
